issue_request: FHIR-16887 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core CodeSystem correction requesting that the generated Code System data-type page section number stop ending in `.null` and instead use a normal numbered section.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 14813. In git, that is commit c8f9012755f9d53b3b3b5ec78d76e02bb50a5f6a, `GF#16887 - fix vs & cs numbering`, which changed the publisher from using OID-tail-derived values for ValueSet and CodeSystem generated page section numbers to explicit ValueSet/CodeSystem counters.
additional_context: The current source no longer has a distinct `codesystem-data-types` source target. The current type terminology uses `source/terminologies/codesystem-fhir-types.xml`, while `valueset-data-types.xml` and `valueset-fhir-types.xml` include `http://hl7.org/fhir/fhir-types`. CodeSystem remains an active resource in `source/fhir.ini`, and CodeSystem pages are generated through `source/hierarchy.xml`. Current build pages for `codesystem-fhir-types.html` and `valueset-data-types.html` show numeric section counts and no `.null`. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current specification already satisfies the requested generated-page numbering correction, and the only known application was a historical tooling fix that is already in the current branch history.
